tasks.label: ai-provider-switcher: package (windows shell)
tasks.command: cd /d C:\Users\63409\Desktop\claude配置 && npx vsce package

tasks.label: ai-provider-switcher: git status
tasks.command: git --no-pager status --short && echo ==== && git --no-pager diff --stat --ignore-space-at-eol | tail -8

tasks.label: ai-provider-switcher: stage and review
tasks.command: git add -A && git status --short && git --no-pager diff --cached --stat | tail -30

tasks.label: ai-provider-switcher: commit, tag and push
tasks.command: git commit -m "feat: Claude CLI sync, Claude Desktop management, and release 0.5.0" -m "Sync the terminal Claude CLI via ~/.claude/settings.json env, add independent Claude Desktop management through the app's 3P config library with model aliases and install discovery, add Remote-SSH/WSL/container awareness, and improve gateway model discovery. Sync the README's English sections with the Chinese docs." && git tag -a v0.5.0 -m "AI Provider Switcher 0.5.0" && git push origin main --tags

tasks.label: ai-provider-switcher: package release
tasks.command: npx vsce package && dir /b *.vsix && where gh && gh auth status

tasks.label: ai-provider-switcher: create GitHub release
tasks.command: gh release create v0.5.0 ai-provider-switcher-0.5.0.vsix --title "AI Provider Switcher 0.5.0" --notes-file release-notes-0.5.0.md --repo Silver-Zhang/ai-provider-switcher && del release-notes-0.5.0.md
